analysis.title: 3Q26 SaaS Earnings Roundup – FRSH & SPT
key_insights: FRSH delivered large profitability upside in 3Q26 but revenue was essentially in line versus a historical average beat of ~1.5pts, and 4Q guidance was in line. MS keeps FRSH Equal-weight.
FRSH billings growth slowed to 11% YoY from 15% in Q2 (12% cc from 16%). EX ARR growth moderated to 22% YoY cc from 23% in Q2.

The 4Q outlook implies ~22% organic EX ARR growth in constant currency after excluding $8-10M of acquired ARR from Torii and Robusta. This raises questions about management's mid-20s EX growth aspiration for 2027.
A faster shift from upfront Device42 term-license revenue to ratable cloud revenue moved ~$2M of expected 4Q revenue into later periods, a modest headwind to guidance.
FRSH EX NDR excluding legacy Device42 customers slipped to >109% from ~111% in 2Q. Analysts want stabilization and an inflection before gaining confidence in the cross-sell opportunity.

About 70% of FRSH's ~20,000 Freshservice customers use only one EX product. Management sees hundreds of millions of dollars in incremental ARR from cross-selling. Cloud ITAM has signed over 400 customers since its 2Q launch versus an initial expectation of fewer than 100.
FRSH non-GAAP operating margin reached 30% (+600bps QoQ, +900bps YoY), beating the high end of guidance by ~$12M. Adjusted FCF margin was also 30%. FY26 adjusted FCF outlook was raised to ~$265M.
FRSH CX ARR growth was 4% YoY (from 3% in Q2). Average pipeline opportunity size doubled over the past year, with some sales-cycle elongation.
FRSH price target rises to $15 from $13 on a roll-forward to FY28 valuation, using ~2.5x Sales (front-office peers 2-3x), implying ~8x EV/FCF.
SPT 3Q26 revenue was $125.1M, up 8.3% YoY. Non-GAAP operating income was $26.3M for a 21% margin, up 910bps YoY and an all-time quarterly high, helped by the July workforce reduction.

SPT expects its first GAAP-profitable quarter in 4Q26. FY26 non-GAAP operating income guidance was raised 13% at the midpoint to $77.8M-$78.8M. The 3Q margin should not be read as a normalized run rate.
SPT 4Q revenue guidance of $124.2M-$125.2M is ~50bps below Street and implies roughly 3% YoY growth, down from 8% in 3Q26.
SPT cRPO growth slowed to 8% from 12% in Q2 and 10% in Q1, with cRPO-bookings near flat. The $30K+ ARR customer count was flat sequentially at 3,925.

SPT weakness is concentrated downmarket. $30K+ subscription revenue grew 18% YoY (from 20% in Q2) and ACV grew 12% (from ~15%). Management cited AI budget competition, more approval stakeholders, longer sales cycles and tougher ROI requirements.

SPT Trellis adoption is progressing, with thousands of customers and early Trellis Plus purchases, but no revenue contribution was disclosed. FCF rose 158% YoY to $26.7M, with more than $26M of buybacks in the quarter.
SPT price target rises to $13 from $11 on a roll-forward to FY28, partly offset by slightly lower out-year revenue, at 1.3x Sales (SaaS peers ~1-2x). Rating stays Equal-weight.
MS AlphaSignals reaction: FRSH results in line versus consensus and SPT modest upside. Next-12-month consensus EPS direction is a modest revision higher for both. Thesis impact is unchanged for both.

market_movers.rationale: PT raised from $13 on a FY28 valuation roll-forward at ~2.5x Sales. Margin upside is offset by slowing EX growth, softer NDR and longer enterprise sales cycles.
PT raised from $11 on a FY28 roll-forward at 1.3x Sales. Restructuring lifted margins, but Q4 guide is below Street and FY27 reacceleration depends on Trellis monetization.

sector_views.rationale: MS industry view on North America Software is Attractive, though the note is cautious on forward revenue growth at FRSH and SPT.

earnings_insights: FRSH 3Q26 (reported 11/2026): total revenue $245.4M, +14.1% YoY, essentially in line with expectations versus a ~1.5pt average historical beat. Non-GAAP operating income $73.2M (29.8% margin). Non-GAAP EPS $0.22. Adjusted FCF $73.9M (30.1% margin).

FRSH 4Q26 guidance was in line. MS 4Q26E revenue is $254.1M (+14.1% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $0.21. FY26E revenue is $965.5M, EPS $0.71, and adjusted FCF $264.9M. MS FY26E EPS $0.71 compares with consensus $0.67, and MS FY26E EBIT $238M with consensus $224M.
FRSH MS estimate changes: FY27E non-GAAP operating income raised to $276.9M from $251.4M, EPS to $0.94 from $0.84. FY28E EPS is $1.05 versus $0.93 before.
SPT 3Q26 (reported): revenue $125.1M, +8.3% YoY, a modest beat. Non-GAAP operating income $26.3M (21% margin, MS model 21.0%). EPS $0.45 versus MS prior estimate $0.30. FCF $26.7M.
SPT 4Q26 revenue guidance $124.2M-$125.2M, ~50bps below Street, ~3% YoY growth. MS 4Q26E revenue is $124.7M, EPS $0.37. FY26E revenue is $495.2M, EPS $1.31.

SPT MS estimate changes: FY27E revenue cut 2.0% to $517.0M, while FY27E operating income rises to $118.6M from $100.9M and EPS to $1.98 from $1.57. FY26E EPS $1.31 compares with consensus $1.11 and EBIT $70M with consensus $51M (Refinitiv).
SPT cRPO was $280.2M, +8% YoY in 3Q. RPO was $393.9M, +10% YoY.
risk_factors: FRSH: increased competition pressures customer adds, aggressive pricing and investment slow margin expansion, macro weakness hits mid-market customers.
FRSH: EX NDR fails to stabilize and enterprise sales cycles lengthen, leaving the mid-20s EX growth target for 2027 unmet.
SPT: downmarket weakness persists, longer sales cycles delay recovery, and Trellis adoption fails to monetize.
SPT: AI investment competes for customer budgets, with more approval stakeholders and tougher ROI/TCO requirements.
vol_and_positioning: FRSH hedge-fund sector long/short ratio is 2.2x and net exposure 30.6%. Institutional owners % active is 49.5% for FRSH and 49.3% for SPT.

tension_points.bull_case: Margin upside, 400+ cloud ITAM customers since the 2Q launch (vs. an expectation of under 100) and ~70% of ~20,000 Freshservice customers on one EX product point to hundreds of millions of dollars in cross-sell ARR.
tension_points.bear_case: A narrow revenue beat, in-line 4Q guide, ~22% organic EX growth, EX NDR down to >109% from ~111% and longer enterprise sales cycles question the mid-20s EX growth aspiration for 2027.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A stabilization and inflection in EX NDR would support the bull case. Continued NDR declines or EX growth below mid-20s would undercut it.

tension_points.bull_case: $30K+ expansion, a stabilizing sub-$30K cohort and Trellis monetization drive FY27 reacceleration, with $30K+ subscription revenue up 18% YoY.
tension_points.bear_case: Q4 guide implies ~3% growth, cRPO growth slowed to 8%, $30K+ customer adds were flat and downmarket weakness persists. Trellis revenue is undisclosed.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Evidence of Trellis monetization and stabilization in new business and expansion would support the bull case. Continued weakness in those metrics keeps shares range-bound.

theme_stances.key_argument: Improved profitability and the multi-product opportunity support the longer-term thesis, but installed-base expansion has not yet translated into organic EX reacceleration.
theme_stances.evidence: we walk away from Q3 more cautious on whether stronger installed-base expansion

theme_stances.key_argument: Softening topline indicators and limited FY27 visibility outweigh the profitability inflection, so shares will likely stay range-bound.
theme_stances.evidence: will likely keep shares range-bound. Remain EW.
